description: Checks if the config version is deprecated and auto-suggests or applies stable fallbacks.
trigger_condition: Before every adapter call, after credential check

input_parameters.description: Version currently parsed by AI into config
True if version is deprecated in catalog

output.on_success: version confirmed or version_override applied with reason logged
output.on_failure: warning attached to simulation report, pipeline continues with selected version

error_codes.HOOK_001: Provided version string does not exist in catalog.
error_codes.HOOK_003: Warning: Auto-upgrade schema incompatible, falling back to deprecated version.

example_log_entry.result: OVERRIDE - Replaced deprecated v1 with stable v3.
